title: MOSOKO_Arabic_Marhaba_7e62ae62
style: Educational pop with world music influences. Acoustic guitar strums syncopated rhythms alongside a bright, clean electric guitar playing melodic counterpoints. A punchy electric bass follows the kick drum pattern. Percussion includes a standard drum kit with a crisp snare and a shaker providing constant sixteenth-note subdivision. Male lead vocals are clear and forward in the mix, supported by group harmony vocals in the chorus. The arrangement features a glockenspiel or high-pitched bell synth doubling the main melody. Key of G major, 115 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[acoustic guitar strumming, shaker, bright electric guitar melody]

Marhaba, hello in Arabic
Assalamu alaikum, classic
Shukran, thank you with grace
Min fadlak, please every place

[group harmony vocals, full drums and bass enter]
Marhaba, kayfa halak? How are you?
Tasharrafna, nice to meet you
Ma'asalaama, see you soon
[electric guitar riff]
Learn a new tune

[Verse 2]
[acoustic guitar and shaker continue]
Asif, I'm sorry friend
La shukran, no problem blend
Ayna? Where is it?
Mahammam, basics visit

[Outro]
[group vocals]
Marhaba, shukran, min fadlak
Ma'asalaama
[final acoustic guitar chord]
